caption: The drawing depicts two rectangular wooden blocks, each featuring carved designs. The upper block is a light brown color with darker shading to suggest depth and dimension. It contains two adjacent carved panels: the left panel has a stylized thistle with symmetrical leaves, while the right panel depicts a round, enclosed flower with leaves on a stem, both framed by leafy borders. The lower block, shaded similarly in light brown tones, presents a single carved rectangle with a repetitive vertical pattern resembling a row of elongated diamonds or leaves, also bordered by a leafy motif. Both blocks are rendered with attention to the wood grain and carving details, and they are placed against a plain, off-white background. The artist’s signature “JOHN A. NILES” appears near both blocks.
title: Mold
